host.kind: cloud VM, not the lab host
host.allocator: system malloc (the capture example sets no global allocator)

binary.engine_tree: vendor/mistralrs-strata b7ca929 (patches 0001-0010 on e68287e), CPU features

kq.generator: harness/synthetic-moe/make_qwen35moe_gguf.py (defaults: 16 experts, top-4, hidden 512, moe_inter 256, 4 layers, Q2_K gate/up + Q3_K down)

protocol.measure: tools/rusage.py wraps one capture process: RUSAGE_CHILDREN plus the GNOSTRAL_METRICS line
protocol.order: interleaved: scaling run kq, kq64, f32 x2; A/B kq64 default, kq64 tuned, kq default, kq tuned x2

identity.captures_default_vs_tuned_malloc: byte-identical for kq and kq64, both runs

pmp.workload: kq fixture, the same 4 prompts x 32 tokens, default malloc
